note: Torah LM2/23 has zero bechina-type edges in the dataset (the single edge with reference 1023 is type 'eitza', not 'bechina'). The Torah is a very short, single-idea teaching structured almost entirely as a mashal (parable) followed by its application. Its logical structure is causal throughout — joy causes melancholy to step aside, and actively bringing melancholy into joy causes it to transform. No conceptual equivalences (bechinas) are formally encoded in the dataset. See torah_23_additions.json for bechina-language identified in the source text that is absent from the dataset.
